learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the basics of accident prevention regulations (UVV) and personal protective equipment (PSA)
Knowledge of the professional production of a press-fit joint
Knowledge of the professional production of flow drill holes and the subsequent thread forming process
Bonding: Knowledge of adhesive types and their applications, the pretreatment of bonding surfaces, and the professional execution of bonds

Brazing/Soldering: Knowledge of the professional creation of a brazed/soldered joint (soft and hard soldering/brazing), types of solder/brazing filler metal and their applications, and the proper pretreatment of soldering/brazing surfaces
Riveting: Knowledge of the professional production of cold, hot, and blind rivet joints and the preparation of the joining surfaces
Press-joining: Knowledge of the production of a transverse press-fit connection and its disassembly, and the necessary devices for this
Screw connections: Knowledge of the different types of screws and their strength classes and tightening torques
Welding: Knowledge of different welding processes and the requirements for welding thin sheets using shielded metal arc welding and TIG welding, and the dangers when welding carbonaceous materials

syllabus_topics: UVV: Accident prevention regulations: importance and handling
PSA: Protective equipment for eyes, ears, hands, feet, and torso, each adapted to the different experimental contents
Advantages and disadvantages of the respective joining process
Application possibilities and limits of the process
Flow drill holes: process flow, tools, equipment
Bonding: adhesion, cohesion, binding components, surface energy and tension, creating an adhesive bond, influences on the strength of an adhesive bond, design of bonding surfaces

Brazing/Soldering: basics of brazing/soldering - wetting, diffusion and capillarity, types of solder/brazing filler metal and application, errors in the brazing/soldering process, design of brazing/soldering surfaces
Riveting: types of connections (cold and hot rivet connections), rivet types and processing options, design of rivet connections
Press-joining: production and disassembly of longitudinal, transverse, and oil press-fit connections
Screw connections: functionality of screw connections, tightening procedures, design guidelines
Welding: basics and application of oxy-fuel, shielded metal arc, TIG welding and performing a U-seam and fillet weld using shielded metal arc welding
assessment_rules: The type of examination (written exam, oral exam, or project work) will be determined at the beginning of the semester. Credit points are awarded upon passing the examination.
